issues.message: Source/port at (0.008, 0.005, 0.0) is within 2 cells (1mm) of the domain edge on the z-axis, just past which the CPML absorber is active. Fields there carry CPML fringe/reflection error; move inward for claims-bearing measurement.

Wire port at (0.008, 0.005, 0.0) (extent 0.002): its MIDPOINT V/I probe cell (center (0.008, 0.005, np.float64(0.00125))) lands inside PEC geometry 'pec'. S-parameters from this port are silently corrupted (measured: near-null forward transmission + over-unity reverse). Shorten/lengthen the extent or move the port so the midpoint cell sits in dielectric (issue #314).

1 PEC volume(s) are exactly ONE cell thick along some axis and are realized as a filled slab with walls on BOTH faces (every E edge between the two faces is shorted; lattice ownership contract #931 §1.2): geometry[0] 'pec' (Box) is one cell thick along z [z: walls at 1mm and 1.5mm (drawn 1mm -> 1.5mm)]. If this is foil (a ground plane, patch or trace), declare it as a SHEET — add_thin_conductor(shape), or a zero-thickness Box via add() — which realizes on ONE node plane with the normal E edge through it live; a slab and a sheet are different conductors on this lattice. If it is a plate, an iris or a wall drawn one cell thick on purpose, no action is needed (report-only). COVERAGE: examined 1 PEC volume(s) on the uniform lane through rfx.boundaries.pec.realized_wall_planes. STALE IF: realized_wall_planes on the named entry's own edge masks returns planes more than one index apart.

issues.message: face x_lo is declared cpml with 6 layers. face x_hi is declared cpml with 6 layers. face y_lo is declared cpml with 6 layers. face y_hi is declared cpml with 6 layers. face z_lo is declared cpml with 6 layers. face z_hi is declared cpml with 6 layers. CPML reference reflections measured at 1 mm cells with the shipped CFS alpha (#1272, #1346): 6 layers: -38 dB at 2 GHz, -41 dB at 10 GHz, -32 dB at 30 GHz, -13 dB below 1 GHz. These reference values do not predict reflection on a different mesh or for UPML. Use at least 8 absorbing layers; 16 layers is the default recommendation.
